notes.title: Added Ultrawide Monitor Support
notes.content:
UI should now display properly on ultrawide monitors
 Changed how some save data is handled. This will prevent bugs going forward, but also unfortunately will likely render old save files unusable.
 Bug fixes

notes.title: Demo Hotfix
notes.content:
Updated text to reflect recent changes
 Bug fixes

notes.title: Reworked Lantern Weapon
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44016449/46c43dfbb9ee91a14d8ccc4b6bcea119415c19ef.gif


 Reworked Lantern Weapon. It now has a playstyle that is more distinct from the other weapons.
 Significant balance changes
 Bug fixes

notes.title: Demo Update: Smoother Combat
notes.content:
Attack animations for the sword have been improved and sped up for a smoother combat experience
Balance changes to account for faster attack speed
Game will no longer freeze when player dies under certain circumstances
Several bug fixes

notes.title: Demo Update: Feedback System
notes.content:
We have added a feedback page in the pause menu. Use it to report any bugs you encounter, or to give us any feedback you have for the game.
 Lots of UI improvements
 Changes to layout to make room for the additional content that will be in the full game
 Balance changes
 Bug fixes

notes.title: Demo Update: Music
notes.content:
Demo Update:

 We have recently brought a composer onto the team. This update replaces all music in the demo with his fantastic work.
 Balance changes, including speeding up many player animations.
 Lots of bug fixes

notes.title: Demo Update QoL Features
notes.content:
Want to try a different build? Now you can talk to the janitor to respec your levels
Now allows up to 4 separate save files
Added new floor designs for more visual diversity
Balance changes
Bug fixes

notes.title: Demo Update Options Menu
notes.content:
Update Notes:

Added an options menu with rebindable controls, volume settings, and more.
Added a map for easier navigation.
Lots of bug fixes

notes.title: Demo Update Story Overhaul
notes.content:
Demo Update:

Reworked the story and rewrote most of the dialogue. One new NPC added. The story should be much clearer and delivered in a more interesting way. 
Increased the joke density by approximately 12.8
Lots of bug fixes

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Demo patch notes:

 Reworked all menu UI to be more readable
 Your attacks can no longer move you forward into damaging terrain such as fire
 Improved attack indicator for Swordsman enemies
 Lots of bug fixes

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Several new visual effects have been added to the demo, including an improved dodge effect

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44016449/6a74fb51a225c25e4dad74f41de4bc05a3b30d29.gif

Deflection mechanics have been reworked so that now you can deflect melee attacks to potentially stagger your opponents in addition to deflecting spell projectiles. 

Lots of bug fixes.
